create_make_transforms: create video transforms factory that returns training or evaluation transforms for video classification
build_video_transform: build a video transform pipeline with random resize, horizontal flip, auto augment, and random erasing for training
create_eval_video_transform: create an evaluation video transform that samples multiple spatial views from a video clip
run_tensor_normalize: run tensor normalization by subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation on video frame tensors
review_video_transform_call: review the VideoTransform __call__ method that converts buffers to normalized CTHW tensors with augmentations
